native_output_boundary: Score pre-native-AMP DSP output. Device integration must verify unity/flat AMP or independently characterize downstream processing. Captured velocity-100 response is already in the target.
control_mapping: Integer native anchors raw=CC*256 map to floor(CC*255/127+0.5)/255; interpolate linearly between anchors for fractional raw values.
waveform_policy: Scheduled positions, complete slots, raw samples; no alignment, normalization, DC subtraction, gain fitting or sample-rate conversion.
split_policy: Group identical controls; first occurrence for fitting; all held-out takes scored separately. Method/rank selected on validation, frozen before test evaluation. Retrospective withholding in an already described corpus; no blind new capture.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean of each metric across takes at identical controls; each setting has equal weight in medians and NumPy linear percentiles. Gate level/duration maxima also use grouped absolute errors. Per-take failures are retained as diagnostics; quiet-window residual limits apply to every take.
limitations: Software source only; no physical TR-808 claim.
Fixed Tune/velocity/accent and isolated triggers; no dynamic-control/retrigger-history fidelity.
